topic: GPT-4 Was Trained on More Text Than You Could Read in 20,000 Years
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

GPT-4's brain is bigger than you can even imagine! It 'read' more text than you could in 20,000 human lifetimes! 📚

Here's the mind-blowing scale of its training:
🔹 GPT-4's training data contains roughly 13 trillion 'tokens' – tiny pieces of text.
🔹 A human reading non-stop at 250 words per minute would take over 20,000 years to get through it all!
🔹 This gargantuan dataset allows GPT-4 to understand language, reason, and generate incredibly human-like text.
